newsitem.title: THAILAND: Jan-Mar export value of Thai vehicles, parts jump.
newsitem.headline: Jan-Mar export value of Thai vehicles, parts jump.

text.p: The export value of Thai-assembled vehicles and parts rose sharply in the first three months of 1997 to about 5.02 billion baht ($193 million) from 2.52 billion the same period last year, an industry association said on Tuesday.

The export value of cars and car parts during the January-March period jumped to 3.1 billion baht from 635 million in the same period a year ago, the Thai Automotive Industry Association said in a statement.
The value of motorcycles and motorcycle part exports in the period rose to 1.93 billion baht from 1.89 billion in the same period the previous year, it said.
The total number of passenger cars and commercial vehicles assembled in Thailand in the first three months dipped to 132,239 units from 137,887 in the same period in 1996.
